verdict.rationale: Unleash's own marketing claims you can 'kill anything AI ships, in real time and without redeploys', and its docs say flags toggle features without redeploying. Neither describes the delivery mechanism or propagation latency. The Edge docs cover caching and scale, not update speed. missing for 10: documented streaming or polling mechanism, stated propagation latency or polling interval, hands-on or independent confirmation that kill switches reach SDKs within seconds.
